name: CT-NeRF
aliases: Incremental Optimizing Neural Radiance Field and Poses with Complex Trajectory
definition: An incremental reconstruction optimization pipeline that uses only RGB images (without pose or depth input) to jointly optimize camera poses and scene structure, specifically designed to handle complex trajectories involving large rotations where existing methods fail.
summary: CT-NeRF is an incremental reconstruction pipeline that jointly optimizes camera poses and neural radiance fields from sequential images, handling complex trajectories by using reprojection loss and pose graphs to escape local minima.
